name: Plastic Boys ~Mizuiro no Kimochi~
source:
Main character is a slightly introverted student who studies to prepare for the exam. He is surrounded by foreign students, twins and such unusual things like android. Looks like he won't be able to study in peace.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-august-2002-ever17-out-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名性格略微内向、正在为考试学习的学生。外国留学生、双胞胎，甚至机器人等不同寻常的存在围绕在他身边。看来他是没法安心读书了。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-august-2002-ever17-out-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
